qe: What is the 'Minimum Age' to become a Judge of the Supreme Court?
o: No minimum age (कोई न्यूनतम आयु नहीं)
e: 1. Smart Catch: Samvidhan mein 'Minimum' age ka zikr nahi hai, sirf 'Retirement' age (65) di gayi hai. \n2. Criteria: 5 saal HC Judge ya 10 saal HC Lawyer hona chahiye.

qe: Who has the power to increase the 'Number of Judges' in the Supreme Court?
e: 1. Rule: Article 124(1). Parliament kanoon banakar judges ki ginti badha sakti hai. \n2. Current: Abhi CJI + 33 Judges (Total 34) hain.

qe: The 'Patna High Court' has its bench at?
e: 1. Bihar Special: Patna High Court ki koi dusri bench nahi hai. Poora Bihar Patna se hi chalta hai. \n2. Fact: UP mein Lucknow aur Prayagraj dono hain, par Bihar mein sirf Patna.

qe: Under which Article can a High Court issue Writs for 'Legal Rights' other than Fundamental Rights?
e: 1. Comparison: SC (Art 32) sirf Fundamental Rights ke liye writ deta hai. \n2. Post-Mortem: HC (Art 226) ki writ power SC se 'wider' (badi) mani jati hai kyunki ye legal rights bhi cover karta hai.

qe: The 'Contempt of Court' (न्यायालय की अवमानना) power is mentioned in which Article for SC?
e: 1. Logic: SC ek 'Court of Record' hai. Agar koi iski insult kare toh ye khud saza de sakta hai.

qe: Who was the first 'Dalit Chief Justice' of India?
e: 1. History: K.G. Balakrishnan 2007 mein Bharat ke pehle Dalit CJI bane the.

qe: The power of 'Curative Petition' was introduced by SC in which case?
o: Rupa Ashok Hurra vs Ashok Hurra (2002)
e: 1. Post-Mortem: Review petition radd hone ke baad bhi agar 'Injustice' lage toh Curative petition aakhri rasta hota hai. \n2. Logic: Ye 'Injustice' rokne ka extreme step hai.

qe: A Judge of the High Court addresses his 'Resignation' to?
e: 1. Smart Catch: Bhale hi HC state mein ho, par Judges ko appoint aur remove 'President' hi karta hai. Isliye resignation bhi President ko hi jata hai.

qe: The 'Acting Chief Justice' of India is appointed by?
e: 1. Article: 126. Jab CJI ka pad khali ho, toh President kisi bhi SC judge ko Acting CJI bana sakta hai.

qe: Which High Court has the largest 'Jurisdiction' in terms of States covered?
e: 1. Fact: Guwahati HC pehle 7 states ke liye tha, abhi bhi isme 4 states (Assam, Nagaland, Mizoram, Arunachal) aate hain.

qe: What is the retirement age of a Supreme Court judge?
e: 1. Core Concept: Constitutional Tenure. \n2. Logic: SC judge 65 saal tak pad par rehte hain. \n3. Extra Fact: High Court ke judges ki retirement age 62 saal hoti hai, ise 65 karne ka bill aksar charcha mein rehta hai.

qe: Which Article provides for the 'Advisory Jurisdiction' of the Supreme Court?
e: 1. Core Concept: President seeking advice. \n2. Logic: Rashtrapati kisi kanooni sawal par SC ki rai maang sakte hain. \n3. Extra Fact: SC rai dene ke liye majboor nahi hai, aur Rashtrapati us rai ko manne ke liye majboor nahi hain.

qe: What is the 'Original Jurisdiction' of the Supreme Court under Article 131?
o: Disputes between Centre and States (केंद्र और राज्यों के बीच विवाद)
e: 1. Core Concept: Direct entry to SC. \n2. Logic: Agar do states (jaise Bihar aur UP) ya Centre aur State ke beech jhagda ho, toh wo sidha SC jata hai. \n3. Extra Fact: Isme interstate water disputes (nadi jal vivad) shamil nahi hote.

qe: The power of 'Judicial Review' in India is based on:
o: Procedure established by law (कानून द्वारा स्थापित प्रक्रिया)
e: 1. Core Concept: Checking validity of laws. \n2. Logic: Article 13 aur Article 21 ke tehat Court check karta hai ki kanoon Samvidhan ke hisab se bana hai ya nahi. \n3. Extra Fact: Japan se 'Procedure established by law' liya gaya tha, par Maneka Gandhi case ke baad SC 'Due process' bhi follow karta hai.

qe: Who appoints the 'Chief Justice of India' (CJI)?
e: 1. Core Concept: Appointment process. \n2. Logic: President hi CJI aur baaki SC judges ko appoint karte hain. \n3. Extra Fact: Iske liye 'Collegium System' (5 senior-most judges ka group) ki sifaarish li jati hai.

qe: What is 'Public Interest Litigation' (PIL)?
o: Case filed for public good by anyone (किसी के द्वारा जनहित में दायर मामला)
e: 1. Core Concept: Access to justice for poor. \n2. Logic: Agar kisi ke rights ka hanan ho raha hai aur wo court nahi ja sakta, toh koi bhi teesra insaan uske liye case kar sakta hai. \n3. Extra Fact: Justice P.N. Bhagwati ko India mein PIL ka janak (Father of PIL) mana jata hai.

qe: Which Article says that the Supreme Court is a 'Court of Record'?
e: 1. Core Concept: Court of Record. \n2. Logic: Iska matlab hai SC ke faisle future mein kanoon ki tarah use honge aur SC apni 'Contempt' (avmanna) ke liye saza de sakta hai. \n3. Extra Fact: High Court ke liye yahi power Article 215 mein hai.

qe: By which process are Supreme Court judges removed?
o: Impeachment-like process by Parliament (संसद द्वारा महाभियोग जैसी प्रक्रिया)
e: 1. Core Concept: Judicial Independence. \n2. Logic: Unhe hatana bahut mushkil hai. Dono houses mein 'Special Majority' se resolution pass hona zaroori hai. \n3. Extra Fact: Ground sirf 'Proved Misbehaviour' ya 'Incapacity' ho sakta hai.

qe: Who was the first female judge of the Supreme Court of India?
e: 1. Core Concept: Judicial History. \n2. Logic: M. Fathima Beevi 1989 mein pehli female SC judge bani thin. \n3. Extra Fact: Leila Seth kisi High Court (Himachal) ki pehli female Chief Justice thin.

qe: Article 141 states that the law declared by Supreme Court is:
o: Binding on all courts in India (भारत के सभी न्यायालयों पर बाध्यकारी)
e: 1. Core Concept: Judicial Precedent. \n2. Logic: SC ne jo keh diya, wo poore desh ki har chhoti-badi adalat ko manna hi padega. \n3. Extra Fact: Ye India ki 'Integrated Judiciary' ko dikhata hai.

qe: What is 'Curative Petition'?
o: Last legal resort after Review Petition (पुनर्विचार याचिका के बाद अंतिम कानूनी उपाय)
e: 1. Core Concept: Avoiding injustice. \n2. Logic: Review petition radd hone ke baad bhi agar koi badi galti reh gayi ho, toh Curative petition lagayi jati hai. \n3. Extra Fact: Ye concept 'Rupa Ashok Hurra vs Ashok Hurra' (2002) case se aaya.

qe: Under which Article can SC grant 'Special Leave Petition' (SLP)?
e: 1. Core Concept: Residual Power. \n2. Logic: SC kisi bhi court ya tribunal ke faisle ke khilaaf appeal sunne ki ijazat de sakta hai. \n3. Extra Fact: Ye SC ki discretionary (vivekadhin) power hai, nagrik ka adhikar nahi.

qe: Who is the 'Guardian of the Constitution'?
e: 1. Core Concept: Constitutional Protection. \n2. Logic: Agar koi Samvidhan ke khilaaf kanoon banata hai, toh SC use radd karke Samvidhan ki raksha karta hai. \n3. Extra Fact: SC ko 'Final Interpreter' (antim vyakhyakar) bhi kehte hain.

qe: Where is the High Court of Bihar located?
e: 1. Core Concept: State Judiciary. \n2. Logic: Patna High Court ki sthapna 1916 mein hui thi. \n3. Extra Fact: Iski building 'Baroque' style mein bani hai.

qe: Which Article gives High Courts the power to issue 'Writs'?
e: 1. Core Concept: Writ Jurisdiction. \n2. Logic: Article 32 sirf SC ke liye hai, par 226 HC ko power deta hai. \n3. Extra Fact: HC ki writ power SC se badi hai kyunki wo FR ke alawa normal legal rights par bhi writ de sakte hain.

qe: What is the minimum qualification to be a Supreme Court judge?
o: 10 years experience as HC judge (HC में 5 वर्ष का अनुभव)
10 years as advocate in HC (HC में 10 वर्ष वकालत)
All of the above (Any one condition)
e: 1. Core Concept: Eligibility. \n2. Logic: Ya toh 5 saal judge rahe hon, ya 10 saal vakeel, ya Rashtrapati ki nazar mein bade kanoon-vid hon. \n3. Extra Fact: Samvidhan mein SC judge ke liye koi 'Minimum Age' nahi likhi hai.

qe: The 'Collegium System' is related to:
e: 1. Core Concept: Selection of Judges. \n2. Logic: Isme SC ke 5 senior judges milkar naye judges ke naam sarkar ko bhejte hain. \n3. Extra Fact: Ye system 'Three Judges Cases' ke baad develop hua, Samvidhan mein nahi tha.

qe: Article 142 gives the Supreme Court power to:
e: 1. Core Concept: Extraordinary Power. \n2. Logic: Jab kisi maamle mein kanoon silent ho, toh SC apni marzi se nyay karne ke liye koi bhi order de sakta hai. \n3. Extra Fact: Ram Mandir case mein isi Article ka use hua tha.

qe: Who can increase the 'Number of Judges' in the Supreme Court?
e: 1. Core Concept: Legislative control. \n2. Logic: Article 124 kehta hai ki Sansad kanoon banakar judges ki ginti badha sakti hai. \n3. Extra Fact: Filhal SC mein 34 judges (33 + 1 CJI) hain.

qe: High Court judges submit their resignation to?
e: 1. Core Concept: Appointment vs Resignation. \n2. Logic: Bhale hi wo state mein kaam karein, par unhe appoint President karta hai, isliye resignation bhi wahi jata hai. \n3. Extra Fact: Unhe hatane ki process bhi Parliament mein hi chalti hai.

qe: What is the 'Subordinate Judiciary'?
o: District and Session Courts (जिला और सत्र न्यायालय)
e: 1. Core Concept: Lower Courts. \n2. Logic: HC ke niche aane wale District aur Taluka courts ko subordinate kehte hain. \n3. Extra Fact: District Judge ki appointment Governor karta hai HC ki salah se.

qe: Which High Court has jurisdiction over the largest number of States?
e: 1. Core Concept: Common High Court. \n2. Logic: Pehle Guwahati HC 7 states ke liye tha, ab ye 4 states (Assam, Nagaland, Mizoram, Arunachal) ko cover karta hai. \n3. Extra Fact: Article 231 Sansad ko power deta hai do states ke liye ek HC banane ki.

qe: Can a retired Supreme Court judge practice law in any court?
e: 1. Core Concept: Post-retirement restriction. \n2. Logic: Independence banaye rakhne ke liye unpar India ke kisi bhi court mein practice karne par rok hai. \n3. Extra Fact: High Court judge retire hone ke baad SC aur dusre HC mein practice kar sakta hai.

qe: Which Article deals with the 'Salary of Judges'?
e: 1. Core Concept: Financial Independence. \n2. Logic: Inki salary 'Consolidated Fund' par charged hoti hai, yani Parliament isse rok nahi sakti. \n3. Extra Fact: Salary sirf 'Financial Emergency' mein kam ho sakti hai.

qe: What is 'Judicial Activism'?
o: Courts proactively protecting rights (अदालतों द्वारा सक्रिय रूप से अधिकारों की रक्षा)
e: 1. Core Concept: Proactive Role. \n2. Logic: Jab Executive (sarkar) apna kaam thik se nahi karti, toh Court aage badhkar nirdesh deta hai. \n3. Extra Fact: PIL iska sabse bada tool hai.

qe: Who was the first Chief Justice of India?
e: 1. Core Concept: Historical Firsts. \n2. Logic: Harilal Jekisundas Kania 1950 mein pehle CJI bane. \n3. Extra Fact: Sabse lambe samay tak CJI rehne wale Y.V. Chandrachud hain.

qe: The 'Acting Chief Justice' of SC is appointed by?
e: 1. Core Concept: Temporary vacancy. \n2. Logic: Article 126 ke tehat agar CJI ka pad khali ho, toh President kisi bhi SC judge ko Acting CJI bana sakta hai. \n3. Extra Fact: Iske liye seniority ko hi mukhya adhaar banaya jata hai.

qe: What is 'Ad-hoc Judge' in Supreme Court?
o: Temporary judge for lack of quorum (कोरम की कमी के लिए अस्थायी न्यायाधीश)
e: 1. Core Concept: Quorum fulfillment. \n2. Logic: Agar SC ki baithak ke liye minimum judges (quorum) na hon, toh CJI President ki ijazat se HC judge ko bulata hai. \n3. Extra Fact: Ye sirf Supreme Court mein hota hai, HC mein nahi.

qe: The High Court of Andaman & Nicobar Islands is located in?
e: 1. Core Concept: Extended Jurisdiction. \n2. Logic: Andaman Nicobar Kolkata High Court ke under aata hai. \n3. Extra Fact: Lakshadweep Kerala High Court ke under aata hai.

qe: Who administers the 'Oath' to High Court judges?
qh: हाई कोर्ट के न्यायाधीशों को 'शपथ' कौन दिलाता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: State-level ceremony. \n2. Logic: Appoint President karta hai, par state mein kaam karna hai isliye shapath Governor dilata hai. \n3. Extra Fact: SC judges ko shapath President dilata hai.

qe: What is the maximum number of High Courts in India?
qh: भारत में उच्च न्यायालयों की कुल संख्या कितनी है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Judicial Infrastructure. \\n2. Logic: Filhal 25 HC hain. Andhra Pradesh (Amaravati) sabse naya hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Bihar ka ek hi HC hai (Patna).

qe: A High Court judge can be transferred by?
qh: हाई कोर्ट के जज का तबादला कौन कर सकता है?
o: The President after consulting CJI (CJI की सलाह पर राष्ट्रपति)
e: 1. Core Concept: Transfers. \\n2. Logic: Article 222 ke tehat President hi transfer karta hai CJI ki consultation ke baad. \\n3. Extra Fact: Consultation mein Collegium ke 4 senior judges ki rai zaroori hai.

qe: Which Article provides for 'District Judges' appointment?
qh: जिला न्यायाधीशों की नियुक्ति का प्रावधान कौन सा अनुच्छेद करता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Local Judiciary. \\n2. Logic: Governor hi state HC se consult karke District judges chunta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Iske liye kam se kam 7 saal vakatat (advocate) ka anubhav hona chahiye.

qe: What is 'Epistolary Jurisdiction'?
qh: 'एपिस्टोलरी क्षेत्राधिकार' क्या है?
o: Accepting a letter as a PIL (पत्र को जनहित याचिका के रूप में स्वीकार करना)
e: 1. Core Concept: PIL start. \\n2. Logic: Agar koi garib sirf ek chitthi (letter) ya post-card bhi judge ko likh de, toh use case maan liya jata hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye Justice Bhagwati ke samay se popular hua.

qe: Does India have 'Integrated Judiciary'?
qh: क्या भारत में 'एकीकृत न्यायपालिका' है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Pyramid Structure. \\n2. Logic: SC sabse upar hai, phir HC, phir District Courts. Sab ek hi system ka hissa hain. \\n3. Extra Fact: USA mein dual system hai (Federal aur State alag), par India mein nahi.

qe: Which Article deals with the 'Appellate Jurisdiction' of SC in civil cases?
qh: दीवानी मामलों में SC के 'अपीलीय क्षेत्राधिकार' से कौन सा अनुच्छेद संबंधित है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Right to Appeal. \\n2. Logic: Agar HC certify kare ki is maamle mein kanoon ka bada sawal hai, toh civil appeal SC mein jati hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Article 134 criminal cases ki appeal ke liye hai.

qe: Who decided the dispute about the 'Age' of a judge?
qh: किसी न्यायाधीश की 'आयु' संबंधी विवाद का निर्णय कौन करता है?
o: The President after consulting CJI (CJI की सलाह पर राष्ट्रपति)
e: 1. Core Concept: Administrative decision. \\n2. Logic: President ka faisla aakhri hota hai consultation ke baad. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ise 15th Amendment se joda gaya tha.

qe: What is 'Amicus Curiae'?
qh: 'एमिकस क्यूरी' क्या है?
o: A friend of the court (अदालत का मित्र - निष्पक्ष सलाहकार)
e: 1. Core Concept: Expert Help. \\n2. Logic: Jab court ko kisi complex maamle mein expert ki rai chahiye hoti hai, toh wo kisi vakeel ko Amicus Curiae banata hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Wo kisi party ki taraf se nahi, sirf sach ke liye kaam karta hai.

qe: Which court has the power to review its 'Own' judgment?
qh: किस न्यायालय को अपने 'स्वयं' के निर्णय की समीक्षा करने की शक्ति है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Review Power. \\n2. Logic: Article 137 ke tehat SC apne hi purane faisle ko badal sakta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: High Courts ke paas ye power inherent hoti hai, par SC ke liye Article fix hai.

qe: The 'Power of the Purse' is with Parliament, but who has 'Power of the Pen'?
qh: 'पर्स की शक्ति' संसद के पास है, पर 'कलम की शक्ति' किसके पास है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Power Balance. \\n2. Logic: Judiciary kanoon ki vyakhya karke kisi bhi galat kaam ko radd kar sakti hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Judiciary ko 'Weakest Branch' kaha jata hai kyunki uske paas na sena hai na paisa, sirf 'Kanoon' hai.

qe: What is the 'Territorial Jurisdiction' of a High Court?
qh: एक उच्च न्यायालय का 'क्षेत्रीय क्षेत्राधिकार' क्या है?
o: The State/UT it belongs to (संबंधित राज्य या केंद्र शासित प्रदेश)
e: 1. Core Concept: Boundary of Power. \\n2. Logic: Patna HC sirf Bihar ke andar ke maamlo ko sun sakta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: SC poore India ke maamle sunta hai.

qe: Article 227 gives High Courts 'Superintendence' over:
qh: अनुच्छेद 227 उच्च न्यायालयों को किस पर 'अधीक्षण' की शक्ति देता है?
o: All courts and tribunals in its territory (अपने क्षेत्र के सभी न्यायालयों और ट्रिब्यूनल पर)
e: 1. Core Concept: Administrative Control. \\n2. Logic: HC apne niche ke saare courts ki functioning ko monitor aur control karta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Isme military courts (Sainik adalat) shamil nahi hain.

qe: Who is responsible for the 'Contempt of Court' (कोर्ट की अवमानना) proceedings?
qh: 'कोर्ट की अवमानना' की कार्यवाही के लिए कौन जिम्मेदार है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Self-protection. \\n2. Logic: Agar koi court ka order nahi manta ya judge ko gaali deta hai, toh court use khud saza de sakta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: SC (Art 129) aur HC (Art 215) dono ke paas ye power hai.

qe: Which Fundamental Right provides for 'Judicial Remedy'?
qh: कौन सा मौलिक अधिकार 'न्यायिक उपचार' का प्रावधान करता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Enforcement. \\n2. Logic: Bina court jane ke adhikar ke baaki rights bekar hain. \\n3. Extra Fact: Dr. Ambedkar ne ise 'Heart and Soul' kaha tha.

qe: High Court judges retire at 62. Which Amendment tried to increase it?
qh: HC जज 62 पर रिटायर होते हैं। किस संशोधन ने इसे बढ़ाने की कोशिश की?
e: 1. Core Concept: Tenure change. \\n2. Logic: 114th Amendment Bill ne ise 65 karne ki baat ki thi, par ye abhi tak pass nahi hua hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: 15th Amendment (1963) ne age 60 se 62 ki thi.

qe: Who appoints 'Additional and Acting Judges' in High Court?
qh: हाई कोर्ट में 'अतिरिक्त और कार्यकारी न्यायाधीशों' की नियुक्ति कौन करता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Temporary judges. \\n2. Logic: Article 224 ke tehat kaam badhne par President 2 saal ke liye extra judges rakh sakta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Inki age bhi 62 se zyada nahi honi chahiye.

qe: The Supreme Court in India was established in?
qh: भारत में सुप्रीम कोर्ट की स्थापना कब हुई थी?
e: 1. Core Concept: Institution building. \\n2. Logic: Constitution lagu hone ke do din baad isne Federal Court of India ko replace kiya. \\n3. Extra Fact: Iska udghatan (Inauguration) Chamber of Princes mein hua tha.

qe: Which Article deals with 'Transfer' of certain cases to High Court?
qh: हाई कोर्ट में कुछ मामलों के 'स्थानांतरण' से कौन सा अनुच्छेद संबंधित है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Taking cases from lower courts. \\n2. Logic: Agar lower court mein kanoon ka bada sawal fasa hai, toh HC use apne paas bula sakta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Isse decision fast aur correct hota hai.

qe: What is 'Judicial Independence'?
qh: 'न्यायिक स्वतंत्रता' क्या है?
o: Freedom from interference by Executive/Legislature (कार्यपालिका/विधायिका के हस्तक्षेप से मुक्ति)
e: 1. Core Concept: Impartiality. \\n2. Logic: Nyay tabhi sahi hoga jab judge bina kisi dar ya lalach (minister ke pressure) ke faisla de. \\n3. Extra Fact: Isliye inki salary aur term Constitution mein fix hai.

qe: What was the 'First Judges Case' (1982) related to?
qh: 'प्रथम न्यायाधीश मामला' (1982) किससे संबंधित था?
o: Consultation does NOT mean concurrence (परामर्श का अर्थ सहमति नहीं है)
e: 1. Core Concept: Appointment power debate. \\n2. Logic: SC ne kaha ki President ko CJI se 'consult' karna hai, par unki baat manna zaroori nahi hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ise 'S.P. Gupta Case' bhi kehte hain, jisme Executive (sarkar) zyada powerful thi.

qe: Which case established the 'Collegium System' as we know it today?
qh: किस मामले ने आज के 'कॉलेजियम सिस्टम' को स्थापित किया?
e: 1. Core Concept: Judiciary taking control. \\n2. Logic: SC ne apne purane faisle ko badal diya aur kaha ki 'Consultation' ka matlab 'Concurrence' (sahamati) hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Iske baad CJI ki rai President par 'Binding' (badhyakari) ho gayi.

qe: In the 'Third Judges Case' (1998), how many judges must be consulted by CJI?
qh: 'तीसरे न्यायाधीश मामले' (1998) में CJI को कितने न्यायाधीशों से परामर्श करना चाहिए?
e: 1. Core Concept: Plurality of Judges. \\n2. Logic: Sirf CJI ka faisla nahi chalega, use SC ke 4 sabse senior judges ki team se rai leni hogi. \\n3. Extra Fact: Agar 2 judges bhi mana kar dein, toh CJI wo naam sarkar ko nahi bhej sakta.

qe: Which High Court has the jurisdiction over 'Lakshadweep'?
qh: 'लक्षद्वीप' पर किस उच्च न्यायालय का क्षेत्राधिकार है?
e: 1. Core Concept: UT Jurisdiction. \\n2. Logic: Lakshadweep ke log kanooni maamlo ke liye Ernakulam (Kerala) jate hain. \\n3. Extra Fact: Puducherry Madras High Court ke under aata hai.

qe: Article 215 states that Every High Court shall be a:
qh: अनुच्छेद 215 कहता है कि प्रत्येक उच्च न्यायालय होगा:
e: 1. Core Concept: Legal Authority. \\n2. Logic: HC ke faisle 'Evidence' ki tarah use hote hain aur wo apni avmanna (Contempt) ke liye saza de sakta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: SC ke liye yahi power Article 129 mein hai.

qe: The 'Power of Judicial Review' is mentioned in which Article?
qh: 'न्यायिक समीक्षा' की शक्ति का उल्लेख किस अनुच्छेद में है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Checking law's validity. \\n2. Logic: Article 13 base hai, aur 32/226 wo raste hain jinse Court kanoon ko check karta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Judicial review 'Basic Structure' ka hissa hai, ise koi cheen nahi sakta.

qe: Who was the first Chief Justice of Patna High Court?
qh: पटना उच्च न्यायालय के पहले मुख्य न्यायाधीश कौन थे?
e: 1. Core Concept: Bihar Judicial History. \\n2. Logic: 1916 mein jab Patna HC bana, tab Sir Edward Chamier pehle CJ bane the. \\n3. Extra Fact: Azadi ke baad pehle Indian CJ 'Lakshmi Kant Jha' the.

qe: What is 'Judicial Restraint'?
qh: 'न्यायिक संयम' (Judicial Restraint) क्या है?
o: Courts not interfering in policy matters (नीतिगत मामलों में हस्तक्षेप न करना)
e: 1. Core Concept: Separation of Powers. \\n2. Logic: Iska matlab hai ki Courts ko sarkar ke har kaam mein dakhal nahi dena chahiye jab tak kanoon na toote. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye 'Judicial Activism' ka bilkul ulta (opposite) concept hai.

qe: Under Article 235, who has the 'Control' over Subordinate Courts?
qh: अनुच्छेद 235 के तहत, अधीनस्थ न्यायालयों पर किसका 'नियंत्रण' होता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Integrated Judiciary. \\n2. Logic: District courts ki postings, promotions aur discipline par poora control High Court ka hota hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye Judiciary ki 'Independence' ko protect karne ke liye hai.

qe: The 'Power to Issue Writs' of SC is narrower than HC. Why?
qh: SC की रिट जारी करने की शक्ति HC से कम व्यापक है। क्यों?
o: SC can issue writs ONLY for Fundamental Rights (केवल मौलिक अधिकारों के लिए)
e: 1. Core Concept: Article 32 vs 226. \\n2. Logic: SC sirf Rights ke liye writ nikal sakta hai, par HC Rights ke alawa normal kanooni bhedbhav par bhi writ de sakta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Isliye writ jurisdiction mein HC zyada 'Wide' mana jata hai.

qe: What is the 'Indra Sawhney' Case (1992) famous for?
qh: 'इंद्रा साहनी' मामला (1992) किसके लिए प्रसिद्ध है?
o: OBC Reservation and 50% limit (OBC आरक्षण और 50% सीमा)
e: 1. Core Concept: Reservation Ceiling. \\n2. Logic: SC ne kaha ki total reservation 50% se zyada nahi hona chahiye. \\n3. Extra Fact: Isi case mein 'Creamy Layer' ka concept bhi aaya tha.

qe: Who decides the 'Number of Judges' in a High Court?
qh: उच्च न्यायालय में 'न्यायाधीशों की संख्या' कौन तय करता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Variable Strength. \\n2. Logic: SC ke judges ki ginti Sansad (Parliament) tay karti hai, par HC ke liye ye power President ke paas hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: President kaam (backlog) ke hisab se judges ki sankhya badha sakta hai.

qe: Can a person be appointed as a Judge of more than one High Court?
qh: क्या किसी व्यक्ति को एक से अधिक उच्च न्यायालयों का न्यायाधीश नियुक्त किया जा सकता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Common High Court. \\n2. Logic: Ek hi judge do ya do se zyada states ke HC ka kaam sambhal sakta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye provisions 7th Amendment (1956) se laya gaya tha.

qe: Article 137 allows the SC to review its own judgment. Why?
qh: अनुच्छेद 137 SC को अपने फैसले की समीक्षा करने की अनुमति देता है। क्यों?
o: To correct a manifest error (स्पष्ट गलती सुधारने के लिए)
e: 1. Core Concept: Review Power. \\n2. Logic: Insan se galti ho sakti hai, isliye SC ko adhikar hai ki wo apna faisla sudhar sake agar naye saboot milein. \\n3. Extra Fact: Review petition usi judge ke paas jati hai jisne faisla diya tha.

qe: Which Fundamental Right was used in the 'Triple Talaq' case (Shayara Bano)?
qh: 'तीन तलाक' मामले में किस मौलिक अधिकार का उपयोग किया गया था?
o: Both A and B (A और B दोनों)
e: 1. Core Concept: Women's Rights. \\n2. Logic: SC ne ise 'Unconstitutional' mana kyunki ye mahilaon ke barabari aur samman ke adhikar ke khilaaf tha. \\n3. Extra Fact: Isne Article 25 (Religious freedom) par Article 14 aur 21 ko upar rakha.

qe: What is the 'Seal' of the Supreme Court?
qh: सुप्रीम कोर्ट की 'मोहर' क्या है?
o: Ashoka Pillar with Dharma Chakra (अशोक स्तंभ और धर्म चक्र)
e: 1. Core Concept: Symbolism. \\n2. Logic: SC ki seal par Sarnath ke Ashoka pillar ka sher aur uske niche 'Yato Dharmastato Jayah' (Jahan Dharm hai wahan vijay hai) likha hota hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye quote Mahabharata se liya gaya hai.

qe: Article 222 deals with the 'Transfer' of judges. Who is consulted?
qh: अनुच्छेद 222 न्यायाधीशों के 'तबादले' से संबंधित है। किससे सलाह ली जाती है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Judicial independence in transfers. \\n2. Logic: President transfer karta hai, par use CJI se pucha hi padega, aur CJI apne 4 senior judges se pucha. \\n3. Extra Fact: Bina sifaarish ke transfer ko 'Punitive' (sazaye-maut) mana jata hai.

qe: Can the 'High Court' punish for contempt of 'Subordinate Courts'?
qh: क्या 'उच्च न्यायालय' निचली अदालतों की अवमानना के लिए दंड दे सकता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Contempt Power. \\n2. Logic: High Court apne poore state ki judicial integrity ka rakshak hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ise 'Contempt of Courts Act, 1971' ke tehat power milti hai.

qe: The 'Circuit Bench' of a High Court means:
qh: उच्च न्यायालय की 'सर्किट बेंच' का अर्थ है:
o: A temporary court in a different city (दूसरे शहर में अस्थायी अदालत)
e: 1. Core Concept: Justice at doorstep. \\n2. Logic: Agar state bada hai, toh judges dusre city mein jakar kuch din ke liye sunvai karte hain. \\n3. Extra Fact: Patna High Court ki koi circuit bench filhal Bihar mein nahi hai (Sab Patna mein hi hota hai).

qe: What is the 'Gram Nyayalaya' (ग्राम न्यायालय)?
qh: 'ग्राम न्यायालय' क्या है?
o: Mobile village court for speedy justice (त्वरित न्याय के लिए मोबाइल ग्राम न्यायालय)
e: 1. Core Concept: Justice at doorstep. \\n2. Logic: 2008 ke Act ke tehat ye gaon mein saste aur fast nyay ke liye banaye gaye hain. \\n3. Extra Fact: Inme civil aur criminal dono tarah ke chote maamle sune ja sakte hain.

qe: Which case established the 'Doctrine of Basic Structure'?
qh: किस मामले ने 'मूल संरचना का सिद्धांत' स्थापित किया?
e: 1. Core Concept: Constitutional Limit. \\n2. Logic: 1973 mein 13 judges ki bench ne kaha ki Parliament Samvidhan ke 'Basic Structure' (jaise Secularism, Democracy) ko nahi badal sakti. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye India ki judicial history ka sabse bada case mana jata hai.

qe: What is the 'Lok Adalat' (लोक अदालत)?
qh: 'लोक अदालत' क्या है?
o: People's Court for compromise (समझौते के लिए जनता की अदालत)
e: 1. Core Concept: Alternative Dispute Resolution (ADR). \\n2. Logic: Isme dono parties aapas mein baith kar samjhauta karti hain taaki case saalo tak na khiche. \\n3. Extra Fact: Lok Adalat ka faisla 'Final' hota hai aur uske khilaaf koi appeal nahi ho sakti.

qe: Article 131 of the Constitution is related to:
qh: संविधान का अनुच्छेद 131 किससे संबंधित है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Direct cases in SC. \\n2. Logic: Centre aur State ya do States ke beech ke jhagde sidhe SC sunta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye Bihar aur Jharkhand ke beech zameen vivad mein bhi use ho sakta hai.

qe: The 'Power of the Pen' of Judiciary is seen in:
qh: न्यायपालिका की 'कलm की शक्ति' किसमें देखी जाती है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Power balance. \\n2. Logic: Court kisi bhi galat kanoon ko ek pen ke stroke se 'Zero' kar sakta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ise 'Checks and Balances' ka mukhya hissa mana jata hai.

qe: In which case did SC say 'Fundamental Rights and DPSP are like two wheels of a chariot'?
qh: किस मामले में SC ने कहा 'मौलिक अधिकार और DPSP एक रथ के दो पहियों की तरह हैं'?
e: 1. Core Concept: Harmony between Part III and IV. \\n2. Logic: SC ne kaha ki dono ke beech balance zaroori hai, ek dusre se bada nahi hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Isne 42nd Amendment ke us badlav ko radd kiya jisne DPSP ko Rights se upar rakha tha.

qe: Who appoints the 'District Judges' (जिला न्यायाधीश)?
qh: 'जिला न्यायाधीशों' की नियुक्ति कौन करता है?
o: The Governor in consultation with High Court (HC की सलाह पर राज्यपाल)
e: 1. Core Concept: Local Appointments. \\n2. Logic: Article 233 ke tehat Governor hi HC se puch kar inki appointment karta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Iske liye 7 saal ka experience as advocate zaroori hai.

qe: The Supreme Court in India was inaugurated on:
qh: भारत में सुप्रीम कोर्ट का उद्घाटन कब हुआ था?
e: 1. Core Concept: Institutional History. \\n2. Logic: Constitution lagu hone ke 2 din baad isne Federal Court of India ki jagah li. \\n3. Extra Fact: Pehle CJI H.J. Kania the.

qe: Article 124(4) provides for the removal of a judge on which grounds?
qh: अनुच्छेद 124(4) किस आधार पर न्यायाधीश को हटाने का प्रावधान करता है?
o: Proved Misbehaviour or Incapacity (सिद्ध कदाचार या अक्षमता)
e: 1. Core Concept: Security of Tenure. \\n2. Logic: Judges ko sirf inhi do thos (solid) reasons par hataya ja sakta hai, taaki wo bina dar ke kaam karein. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ise 'Impeachment-like' process kehte hain.

qe: Which Court has the power to transfer a case from one High Court to another?
qh: किस न्यायालय के पास एक हाई कोर्ट से दूसरे हाई कोर्ट में मामला स्थानांतरित करने की शक्ति है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Centralized Judicial Control. \\n2. Logic: Agar nyay ke liye zaroori ho, toh SC kisi bhi case ko ek HC se dusre HC mein bhej sakta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Article 139A ye power deta hai.

qe: What is 'Judicial Activism'?
qh: 'न्यायिक सक्रियता' क्या है?
o: Courts proactively protecting rights and environment (अदालतों द्वारा सक्रिय रूप से अधिकारों की रक्षा)
e: 1. Core Concept: Proactive Role. \\n2. Logic: Jab sarkar apna kaam nahi karti, toh Court aage badhkar nirdesh (directions) deta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: PIL iska sabse bada example hai.

qe: Who is the first female Chief Justice of a High Court in India?
qh: भारत में किसी हाई कोर्ट की पहली महिला मुख्य न्यायाधीश कौन थीं?
e: 1. Core Concept: Women in Judiciary. \\n2. Logic: Leila Seth 1991 mein Himachal Pradesh HC ki pehli mahila CJ bani thin. \\n3. Extra Fact: Fathima Beevi SC ki pehli female judge thin (CJ nahi).

qe: Article 142 gives SC the power of 'Complete Justice'. What does it mean?
qh: अनुच्छेद 142 SC को 'पूर्ण न्याय' की शक्ति देता है। इसका क्या अर्थ है?
o: To pass any order to do justice in a case (किसी मामले में न्याय के लिए कोई भी आदेश देना)
e: 1. Core Concept: Extraordinary Power. \\n2. Logic: Jab koi kanoon saaf nahi hota, toh SC apni marzi se nyay karne ke liye naye nirdesh de sakta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ayodhya Case mein isi Article ka use hua tha.

qe: What is the 'Seal' of the Supreme Court of India?
qh: भारत के सुप्रीम कोर्ट की 'मोहर' क्या है?
o: Ashoka Pillar with Dharma Chakra (अशोक स्तंभ और धर्म चक्र)
e: 1. Core Concept: Symbolism. \\n2. Logic: Is par 'Yato Dharmastato Jayah' (Jahan Dharm hai wahan Vijay hai) likha hota hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye quote Mahabharata se liya gaya hai.

qe: Can a person practice law after retiring as a High Court judge?
qh: क्या कोई व्यक्ति हाई कोर्ट के न्यायाधीश के रूप में सेवानिवृत्त होने के बाद वकालत कर सकता है?
o: Yes, but only in SC or other HCs (हाँ, लेकिन केवल SC या अन्य HC में)
e: 1. Core Concept: Post-retirement Practice. \\n2. Logic: Wo usi HC mein practice nahi kar sakte jahan wo judge the, par SC ya dusre HC mein kar sakte hain. \\n3. Extra Fact: SC judge retire hone ke baad kahin practice nahi kar sakta.

qe: Which Article provides for the 'Seat of Supreme Court'?
qh: कौन सा अनुच्छेद 'सुप्रीम कोर्ट की सीट' का प्रावधान करता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Location of SC. \\n2. Logic: SC Delhi mein baithta hai, par CJI President ki ijazat se kahin aur bhi baithak bula sakta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Abhi tak Delhi se bahar koi bench nahi bani hai.

qe: What is 'Public Interest Litigation' (PIL)?
qh: 'जनहित याचिका' (PIL) क्या है?
o: Case filed for public good (जनता की भलाई के लिए दायर मामला)
e: 1. Core Concept: Accessible Justice. \\n2. Logic: Koi bhi vyakti garibo ya samaj ke liye case kar sakta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Justice P.N. Bhagwati ko iska janak mana jata hai.

qe: Who was the Chief Justice of India during the 'Emergency' (1975)?
qh: 'आपातकाल' (1975) के दौरान भारत के मुख्य न्यायाधीश कौन थे?
e: 1. Core Concept: Controversial Appointments. \\n2. Logic: Teen senior judges ko chhod kar (supersede) unhe CJI banaya gaya tha. \\n3. Extra Fact: Isne Judiciary vs Executive ki ladayi ko bada diya tha.

qe: Article 215 says High Court is a 'Court of Record'. What does it mean?
qh: अनुच्छेद 215 कहता है कि हाई कोर्ट एक 'अभिलेख न्यायालय' है। इसका क्या अर्थ है?
o: Its judgments are used as evidence and it can punish for contempt (इसके फैसले सबूत के रूप में उपयोग होते हैं और यह अवमानना के लिए दंड दे सकता है)
e: 1. Core Concept: Judicial Authority. \\n2. Logic: HC ke faislo ki kanooni value hoti hai aur wo kisi ko apni baat na manne par jail bhej sakta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: SC ke liye yahi Article 129 hai.

qe: How many High Courts are there in India currently?
qh: वर्तमान में भारत में कुल कितने उच्च न्यायालय हैं?
e: 1. Core Concept: Judicial Structure. \\n2. Logic: Andhra Pradesh (Amaravati) sabse naya High Court hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Kayi High Courts do ya do se zyada states ke liye common hain.

qe: Which Article provides for 'National Judicial Appointments Commission' (NJAC)?
qh: कौन सा अनुच्छेद 'राष्ट्रीय न्यायिक नियुक्ति आयोग' (NJAC) का प्रावधान करता था?
e: 1. Core Concept: Failed Judicial Reform. \\n2. Logic: Sarkar ne Collegium system hatane ke liye ise laya tha, par SC ne ise 'Unconstitutional' keh kar radd kar diya. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye 99th Amendment Act se aaya tha.

qe: What is 'Curative Petition'?
qh: 'क्यूरेटिव पिटीशन' क्या है?
o: Last legal resort after review petition is rejected (रिव्यू पिटीशन खारिज होने के बाद अंतिम कानूनी रास्ता)
e: 1. Core Concept: Final remedy. \\n2. Logic: Agar review petition ke baad bhi lage ki badi galti hui hai, toh ye lagayi jati hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye Rupa Ashok Hurra case se shuru hui.

qe: Who administers the 'Oath' to Supreme Court judges?
qh: सुप्रीम कोर्ट के न्यायाधीशों को 'शपथ' कौन दिलाता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Appointment Ceremony. \\n2. Logic: Article 124(6) ke tehat President hi unhe shapath dilate hain. \\n3. Extra Fact: HC judges ko Governor shapath dilata hai.

qe: Article 141 states that law declared by SC is:
qh: अनुच्छेद 141 कहता है कि SC द्वारा घोषित कानून है:
o: Binding on all courts in India (भारत के सभी न्यायालयों पर बाध्यकारी)
e: 1. Core Concept: Judicial Precedent. \\n2. Logic: SC ne jo keh diya, wo poore desh ki har adalat ko manna padega. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye Judiciary ko 'Integrated' (ek-joot) banata hai.

qe: What is the tenure of a High Court judge?
qh: हाई कोर्ट के न्यायाधीश का कार्यकाल कितना होता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Judicial Tenure. \\n2. Logic: SC ke judge 65 tak rehte hain, par HC ke 62 tak. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ise 65 karne ka prastav aksar charcha mein rehta hai.

qe: Which Article provides for the 'Transfer' of judges from one HC to another?
qh: न्यायाधीशों के एक HC से दूसरे HC में 'स्थानांतरण' का प्रावधान कौन सा अनुच्छेद करता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Administrative Power. \\n2. Logic: President hi CJI ki सलाह par transfers karte hain. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye power bhedbhav rokne aur diversity badhane ke liye use hoti hai.

qe: The High Court of Lakshadweep is located in:
qh: लक्षद्वीप का उच्च न्यायालय कहाँ स्थित है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Judicial Jurisdiction. \\n2. Logic: Lakshadweep Kerala High Court ke under aata hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Andaman & Nicobar Kolkata HC ke under aata hai.

qe: Who is the 'Final Interpreter' of the Indian Constitution?
qh: भारतीय संविधान का 'अंतिम व्याख्याकार' कौन है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Constitutional Authority. \\n2. Logic: Samvidhan mein kya likha hai, uska sahi matlab sirf SC hi bata sakta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: SC ka faisla hi aakhri mana jata hai.

qe: The power of 'Judicial Review' in India is taken from:
qh: भारत में 'न्यायिक समीक्षा' की शक्ति कहाँ से ली गई है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Borrowed Features. \\n2. Logic: America ke Samvidhan se humne ye concept liya hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Isne India ko ek 'Limited Government' banane mein madad ki hai.

qe: What is 'Amicus Curiae'?
qh: 'एमिकस क्यूरी' क्या है?
o: A friend of the court (अदालत का मित्र - स्वतंत्र सलाहकार)
e: 1. Core Concept: Legal Assistance. \\n2. Logic: Jab Court ko kisi complex case mein expert advice chahiye hoti hai, toh wo Amicus Curiae ko bulata hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye kisi bhi party ka vakeel nahi hota, sirf sachai batata hai.

qe: Under the 'Judges Enquiry Act, 1968', how many members of Lok Sabha must sign a motion to remove a judge?
qh: 'न्यायाधीश जांच अधिनियम, 1968' के तहत, न्यायाधीश को हटाने के प्रस्ताव पर लोकसभा के कितने सदस्यों के हस्ताक्षर होने चाहिए?
e: 1. Core Concept: Strict Removal Process. \\n2. Logic: Process shuru karne ke liye LS mein 100 aur RS mein 50 members ka support chahiye. \\n3. Extra Fact: Iske baad ek 3-member committee jaanch karti hai, jisme ek SC judge, ek HC Chief Justice aur ek jurist hota hai.

qe: Which Article provides for the establishment of 'Administrative Tribunals'?
qh: कौन सा अनुच्छेद 'प्रशासनिक न्यायाधिकरण' की स्थापना का प्रावधान करता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Specialized Justice. \\n2. Logic: Sarkari naukar (Govt servants) ke service maamlo ke liye CAT (Central Administrative Tribunal) isi ke tehat bana hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ise 42nd Amendment (1976) dwara Swaran Singh Committee ki report par joda gaya tha.

qe: What is the meaning of 'Master of Roster'?
qh: 'मास्टर ऑफ रोस्टर' का क्या अर्थ है?
o: CJI's power to decide which judge hears which case (यह तय करने की शक्ति कि कौन सा जज किस मामले की सुनवाई करेगा)
e: 1. Core Concept: Administrative Supremacy of CJI. \\n2. Logic: Supreme Court mein CJI hi decide karta hai ki kaun sa case kis bench ke paas jayega. \\n3. Extra Fact: Shanti Bhushan case mein SC ne confirm kiya ki CJI hi 'Master of Roster' hai.

qe: A 'Sessions Judge' has the power to award capital punishment (death sentence). What is the condition?
qh: 'सत्र न्यायाधीश' के पास मृत्युदंड देने की शक्ति होती है। इसकी शर्त क्या है?
o: Must be confirmed by High Court (हाई कोर्ट द्वारा पुष्टि अनिवार्य है)
e: 1. Core Concept: Check on Lower Courts. \\n2. Logic: CrPC (ab BNSS) ke tehat, District level par Sessions judge fansi de toh sakta hai par bina HC ki 'Confirmation' ke fansi di nahi ja sakti. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye safety isliye hai taaki koi galti na ho jaye.

qe: Which Article allows the Supreme Court to punish for 'Contempt of Itself'?
qh: कौन सा अनुच्छेद सुप्रीम कोर्ट को 'स्वयं की अवमानना' के लिए दंड देने की अनुमति देता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Maintaining Dignity. \\n2. Logic: Agar koi SC ke order ko nahi manta ya insult karta hai, toh SC use jail bhej sakta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: High Court ke liye yahi power Article 215 mein hai.

qe: What is the difference between a 'Civil Judge' and a 'Sessions Judge'?
qh: 'सिविल जज' और 'सत्र न्यायाधीश' के बीच क्या अंतर है?
o: Civil Judge hears property/money cases; Sessions Judge hears criminal cases (सिविल जज संपत्ति/पैसे के मामले देखता है; सत्र न्यायाधीश आपराधिक मामले)
One is for Bihar, one for UP
e: 1. Core Concept: Nature of Dispute. \\n2. Logic: Jab wahi judge zameen ya divorce ke case sunta hai toh 'District Judge' kehlata hai, aur jab murder ya chori ke case sunta hai toh 'Sessions Judge'. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye District Judiciary ke do chehre hain.

qe: Which Article provides for 'National Green Tribunal' (NGT) related principles?
qh: 'नेशनल ग्रीन ट्रिब्यूनल' (NGT) से संबंधित सिद्धांतों का प्रावधान कौन सा अनुच्छेद करता है?
o: Both B and C (B और C दोनों)
e: 1. Core Concept: Environmental Justice. \\n2. Logic: NGT Act 2010 mein bana, par iska base Art 21 (Life) aur Art 48A (State's duty to protect environment) hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: NGT ka headquarter Delhi mein hai aur ye environment cases ko 6 mahine mein niptata hai.

qe: The 'Power of Superintendence' of High Court over all courts is under?
qh: सभी न्यायालयों पर उच्च न्यायालय के 'अधीक्षण की शक्ति' किसके अंतर्गत है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Administrative Control. \\n2. Logic: Article 227 HC ko apne territory ke saare Courts aur Tribunals ko guide aur monitor karne ki power deta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Isme 'Armed Forces' (Military) tribunals shamil nahi hote.

qe: Who decides the 'Rules of Procedure' for the Supreme Court?
qh: सुप्रीम कोर्ट के लिए 'प्रक्रिया के नियम' कौन तय करता है?
o: The Supreme Court with approval of President (राष्ट्रपति के अनुमोदन से सुप्रीम कोर्ट स्वयं)
e: 1. Core Concept: Internal Autonomy. \\n2. Logic: Article 145 ke tehat SC apne kaam karne ka tarika khud decide karta hai, par President ki haan zaroori hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Isi ke tehat 'Live Streaming' ke rules bhi banaye gaye hain.

qe: Which High Court was the first to start 'Live Streaming' of its proceedings?
qh: अपनी कार्यवाही की 'लाइव स्ट्रीमिंग' शुरू करने वाला पहला हाई कोर्ट कौन सा था?
e: 1. Core Concept: Transparency in Justice. \\n2. Logic: Gujarat HC ne YouTube par sunvai dikhana shuru kiya taaki log nyay prakriya ko samajh sakein. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ab Supreme Court ki constitutional benches ki sunvai bhi live hoti hai.

qe: What is 'Judicial Indiscipline'?
qh: 'न्यायिक अनुशासनहीनता' क्या है?
o: Lower court not following higher court's ruling (निचली अदालत द्वारा उच्च न्यायालय के आदेश का पालन न करना)
e: 1. Core Concept: Hierarchy of Courts. \\n2. Logic: Article 141 ke tehat SC ka faisla binding hai. Agar koi HC ya District court use ignore kare, toh ise indiscipline mana jata hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Iske liye Contempt of Court proceedings ho sakti hain.

qe: Can the 'Supreme Court' review its own decision?
qh: क्या 'सुप्रीम कोर्ट' अपने ही फैसले की समीक्षा कर सकता है?
o: No, once decided it is final
Yes, under Article 137 (हाँ, अनुच्छेद 137 के तहत)
e: 1. Core Concept: Corrective Justice. \\n2. Logic: SC ko lagta hai ki pichle faisle mein koi badi galti ho gayi hai (Error of law), toh wo use badal sakta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Kesavananda Case ne Golaknath Case ke faisle ko review karke hi badla tha.

qe: Who is called the 'Sentinel on the Qui Vive' (alert guardian) of Fundamental Rights?
qh: मौलिक अधिकारों का 'प्रहरी' (Sentinel on the Qui Vive) किसे कहा जाता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Active Protection. \\n2. Logic: Supreme Court hamesha alert rehta hai ki sarkar koi galat kanoon na banaye. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye term Justice S.S. Das ne ek famous judgment mein use kiya tha.

qe: Article 139A gives SC the power to 'Withdraw Cases'. From where?
qh: अनुच्छेद 139A SC को 'मामले वापस लेने' की शक्ति देता है। कहाँ से?
o: From one or more High Courts (एक या अधिक हाई कोर्ट से अपने पास मँगाना)
e: 1. Core Concept: Unified Justice. \\n2. Logic: Agar alag-alag HCs mein ek hi jaise case chal rahe hon, toh SC unhe apne paas bula leta hai taaki poore desh mein ek hi faisla aaye. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ise 42nd Amendment se joda gaya tha.

qe: What is the 'Seal of the Supreme Court' composed of?
qh: सुप्रीम कोर्ट की 'मोहर' किससे बनी है?
o: Sarnath Ashoka Capital with Dharma Chakra (सारनाथ अशोक स्तंभ और धर्म चक्र)
e: 1. Core Concept: State Identity. \\n2. Logic: SC ki seal mein 24-spokes wala Dharma chakra hota hai jo 'Rule of Law' ko dikhata hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Iske niche likha hota hai- 'Yato Dharmastato Jayah'.

qe: Can a High Court judge be appointed as an 'Acting Chief Justice' of that HC?
qh: क्या किसी हाई कोर्ट के जज को उसी HC का 'कार्यकारी मुख्य न्यायाधीश' नियुक्त किया जा सकता है?
o: Yes, under Article 223 (हाँ, अनुच्छेद 223 के तहत)
Only if he is from Bihar
e: 1. Core Concept: Filling Vacancy. \\n2. Logic: Agar CJ ka pad khali ho, toh President usi HC ke kisi judge ko temporary CJ bana sakta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Seniority isme mukhya factor hota hai.

qe: What is the 'Family Court Act, 1984' related to?
qh: 'पारिवारिक न्यायालय अधिनियम, 1984' किससे संबंधित है?
o: Marriage and matrimonial disputes (शादी और वैवाहिक विवाद)
e: 1. Core Concept: Specialized Civil Courts. \\n2. Logic: Shaadi, divorce aur bacchon ki custody ke maamle normal courts se alag, narm mahaul mein sune jate hain. \\n3. Extra Fact: Bihar ke lagbhag har district mein Family Court maujood hai.

qe: What is 'Judicial Review' of 'Constitutional Amendments'?
qh: 'संविधान संशोधनों' की 'न्यायिक समीक्षा' क्या है?
o: SC can radd any amendment that breaks Basic Structure (SC उस संशोधन को रद्द कर सकता है जो मूल संरचना को तोड़ता है)
e: 1. Core Concept: Limit on Parliament. \\n2. Logic: Kesavananda case ke baad, Parliament Samvidhan badal toh sakti hai, par uska 'Dancha' (structure) nahi tod sakti. \\n3. Extra Fact: 99th Amendment (NJAC) isi logic par radd kiya gaya tha.

qe: Who is the final authority to decide the 'Age' of a High Court judge?
qh: हाई कोर्ट के जज की 'आयु' तय करने वाला अंतिम प्राधिकारी कौन है?
o: President after consulting CJI (CJI से परामर्श के बाद राष्ट्रपति)
e: 1. Core Concept: Administrative decision. \\n2. Logic: Article 217(3) ke tehat agar age par vivad ho, toh President ka decision final hota hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ise 15th Amendment (1963) se joda gaya tha.

qe: What is 'Open Court' principle?
qh: 'ओपन कोर्ट' सिद्धांत क्या है?
o: Trials should be conducted in public view (सुनवाई जनता की नज़रों के सामने होनी चाहिए)
e: 1. Core Concept: Public Confidence. \\n2. Logic: Justice sirf hona nahi chahiye, hote hue dikhna bhi chahiye. \\n3. Extra Fact: Exceptions 'In-camera' trials (rape or sensitive cases) mein hote hain jahan public allowed nahi hoti.

qe: Under Article 143, is the President bound to follow SC's advice?
qh: अनुच्छेद 143 के तहत, क्या राष्ट्रपति SC की सलाह मानने को बाध्य हैं?
e: 1. Core Concept: Non-binding advice. \\n2. Logic: SC sirf ek 'Opinion' deta hai, faisla President ka hi hota hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ayodhya Case (1993) mein SC ne advice dene se hi mana kar diya tha.

qe: Which judge is known as the 'Public Interest Judge' of India?
qh: भारत के किस न्यायाधीश को 'जनहित न्यायाधीश' के रूप में जाना जाता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Father of PIL. \\n2. Logic: Unhone hi kanoon ko garibo tak pahunchane ke liye rules dheele kiye. \\n3. Extra Fact: Unke sath Justice Krishna Iyer ka bhi bada role tha.

qe: What is the 'Substantive Question of Law'?
qh: 'कानून का सारभूत प्रश्न' क्या है?
o: A complex legal point that needs interpretation (एक जटिल कानूनी बिंदु जिसे व्याख्या की आवश्यकता है)
e: 1. Core Concept: Certification for Appeal. \\n2. Logic: Jab kisi case ka result Samvidhan ki kisi line ke matlab par tika ho, tabhi wo HC se SC ja sakta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Article 132-134 mein iska zikr hai.

qe: Who was the only CJI to act as the President of India?
qh: भारत के राष्ट्रपति के रूप में कार्य करने वाले एकमात्र CJI कौन थे?
e: 1. Core Concept: Constitutional Line of Succession. \\n2. Logic: 1969 mein President aur VP dono na hone par CJI Hidayatullah Acting President bane the. \\n3. Extra Fact: Wo baad mein India ke Vice-President bhi chune gaye.

qe: Article 138 allows 'Enlargement of Jurisdiction' of SC by?
qh: अनुच्छेद 138 SC के क्षेत्राधिकार को बढ़ाने की अनुमति किसके द्वारा देता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Legislative Power over Judiciary. \\n2. Logic: Sirf Sansad hi SC ko naye maamle sunne ki extra power de sakti hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye power Union List ke subjects tak limited hai.

qe: What is 'Court of Record' (अभिलेख न्यायालय)?
qh: 'अभिलेख न्यायालय' (Court of Record) क्या है?
o: Court whose proceedings are preserved as evidence (न्यायालय जिसकी कार्यवाही साक्ष्य के रूप में सुरक्षित रखी जाती है)
e: 1. Core Concept: Legal Authority. \\n2. Logic: SC aur HC ke faisle 'Evidence' mane jate hain, unhe koi jhutla nahi sakta. \\n3. Extra Fact: Inhe ignore karna 'Contempt' mana jata hai.

qe: Which Article deals with 'All India Judicial Service'?
qh: 'अखिल भारतीय न्यायिक सेवा' से कौन सा अनुच्छेद संबंधित है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Centralized recruitment of judges. \\n2. Logic: Agar Rajya Sabha chahe toh IAS ki tarah Judges ke liye bhi UPSC jaisa exam shuru karwa sakti hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ise 42nd Amendment se joda gaya tha, par abhi tak ye service bani nahi hai.

qe: What is 'Natural Justice' (प्राकृतिक न्याय) in judiciary?
qh: न्यायपालिका में 'प्राकृतिक न्याय' क्या है?
o: Fair hearing and no bias (निष्पक्ष सुनवाई और कोई पूर्वाग्रह नहीं)
e: 1. Core Concept: Core of Judiciary. \\n2. Logic: 'Audi Alteram Partem' (dusre side ko bhi suno) aur 'Nemo judex in causa sua' (koi apne case mein judge nahi banega). \\n3. Extra Fact: Agar ye follow na ho, toh HC Article 226 mein faisla radd kar deta hai.

qe: Can the 'High Court' issue writs for purposes OTHER than Fundamental Rights?
qh: क्या हाई कोर्ट मौलिक अधिकारों के अलावा अन्य उद्देश्यों के लिए रिट जारी कर सकता है?
o: Yes, under Article 226 (हाँ, अनुच्छेद 226 के तहत)
e: 1. Core Concept: Wide Jurisdiction of HC. \\n2. Logic: HC kisi bhi normal kanooni bhedbhav (legal rights) par writ nikal sakta hai, par SC (Art 32) sirf FR par. \\n3. Extra Fact: Isliye HC ki writ power SC se zyada wide maani jati hai.

qe: Which case is known as the 'Fundamental Rights Case' in Indian history?
qh: भारतीय इतिहास में किस मामले को 'मौलिक अधिकार मामला' कहा जाता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Largest Bench. \\n2. Logic: Isme 13 judges ki bench ne FR aur Preamble par historical faisla diya tha. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye case Kerala ki 'Edneer Mutt' ki zameen se shuru hua tha.

qe: What is the 'Doctrine of Laches' often applied by High Courts?
qh: हाई कोर्ट द्वारा अक्सर लागू किया जाने वाला 'विलंब का सिद्धांत' (Doctrine of Laches) क्या है?
o: Delay in filing a case can lead to rejection (मामला दायर करने में देरी से याचिका खारिज हो सकती है)
e: 1. Core Concept: Time is essence. \\n2. Logic: Court kehta hai ki 'Equity helps the vigilant, not the indolent'. Agar aap apne haq ke liye bahut saalo baad aate hain, toh Court sunvai se mana kar sakta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Writ petitions (Art 226) mein ye doctrine bahut zyada use hoti hai.

qe: Who was the only judge to give a 'Dissenting Opinion' in the ADM Jabalpur (Emergency) case?
qh: ADM जबलपुर (आपातकाल) मामले में 'असहमति' जताने वाले एकमात्र न्यायाधीश कौन थे?
e: 1. Core Concept: Judicial Courage. \\n2. Logic: Emergency mein baaki 4 judges ne sarkar ka sath diya, par H.R. Khanna ne kaha ki Article 21 kabhi khatam nahi ho sakta. \\n3. Extra Fact: Is sachai ki keemat unhe CJI na ban kar chukani padi thi.

qe: Article 139 gives Parliament the power to confer writ-issuing power to SC for?
qh: अनुच्छेद 139 संसद को SC को किसके लिए रिट जारी करने की शक्ति देने का अधिकार देता है?
o: Purposes other than Fundamental Rights (मौलिक अधिकारों के अलावा अन्य उद्देश्यों के लिए)
e: 1. Core Concept: Narrow vs Wide Writ Power. \\n2. Logic: Filhal SC sirf FR par writ deta hai (Art 32). Par Art 139 ke tehat Sansad chahe toh SC ko normal legal matters par bhi writ ki power de sakti hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: High Court ke paas ye wide power Art 226 mein pehle se hai.

qe: What is 'Fast Track Court' (FTC) in the Indian system?
qh: भारतीय प्रणाली में 'फास्ट ट्रैक कोर्ट' क्या है?
o: Special courts for long-pending and heinous cases (लंबे समय से लंबित और जघन्य मामलों के लिए विशेष न्यायालय)
e: 1. Core Concept: Speedy Justice. \\n2. Logic: 11th Finance Commission ki sifaarish par ye banaye gaye the taaki backlog khatam ho sake. \\n3. Extra Fact: Inka sara kharch Central Government uthati hai.

qe: The High Court of 'Delhi' was established in which year?
qh: दिल्ली उच्च न्यायालय की स्थापना किस वर्ष हुई थी?
e: 1. Core Concept: UT with own High Court. \\n2. Logic: Delhi akela aisa UT hai jiska apna High Court shuru se hai (Ab J&K bhi hai). \\n3. Extra Fact: Isse pehle Delhi Punjab HC ke under aata tha.

qe: Under Article 231, Parliament can establish a 'Common High Court' for two or more states.
qh: अनुच्छेद 231 के तहत, संसद दो या दो से अधिक राज्यों के लिए 'साझा उच्च न्यायालय' स्थापित कर सकती है।
e: 1. Core Concept: Shared Infrastructure. \\n2. Logic: Kharch bachane aur efficiency ke liye Sansad aisa karti hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Punjab & Haryana HC iska sabse bada example hai.

qe: What is 'Judicial Legislation'?
qh: 'न्यायिक विधान' क्या है?
o: Judges laying down guidelines in absence of law (कानून के अभाव में न्यायाधीशों द्वारा दिशा-निर्देश तय करना)
e: 1. Core Concept: Filling the Law Gap. \\n2. Logic: Jab kisi mudde (jaise sexual harassment) par kanoon nahi hota, toh SC 'Vishakha Guidelines' jaisi rules banata hai jo kanoon ki tarah kaam karte hain. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ise 'Legislating from the Bench' bhi kehte hain.

qe: Who is the 'Lokayukta' in Bihar?
qh: बिहार में 'लोकायुक्त' कौन है?
o: A retired judge investigating corruption (भ्रष्टाचार की जांच करने वाला सेवानिवृत्त न्यायाधीश)
e: 1. Core Concept: Anti-corruption ombudsman. \\n2. Logic: State level par mantriyo aur officers ki corruption jaanchne ke liye Lokayukta hota hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Bihar ne 1973 mein hi Lokayukta Act pass kar diya tha.

qe: What is the meaning of 'Suo Motu' action by Courts?
qh: अदालतों द्वारा 'सुओ मोटो' (Suo Motu) कार्रवाई का क्या अर्थ है?
o: On its own motion/knowledge (अपनी मर्जी या संज्ञान से)
e: 1. Core Concept: Proactive Justice. \\n2. Logic: Jab Court newspaper padhkar ya social media dekhkar khud hi case shuru kar de (bina kisi ki petition ke). \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye 'Judicial Activism' ka hi ek part hai.

qe: Which Article says 'Law declared by SC binding on all courts'?
qh: कौन सा अनुच्छेद कहता है 'SC द्वारा घोषित कानून सभी न्यायालयों पर बाध्यकारी है'?
e: 1. Core Concept: Vertical Precedent. \\n2. Logic: Ye India ke 'Unified Judicial System' ki neev hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: SC apne khud ke pichle faislo se bandha (binding) nahi hai (Art 137).

qe: What is the 'Collegium' composed of for High Court appointments?
qh: हाई कोर्ट की नियुक्तियों के लिए 'कॉलेजियम' किससे बना होता है?
o: CJI + 2 senior judges of SC (CJI + SC के 2 वरिष्ठ न्यायाधीश)
e: 1. Core Concept: Appointment differences. \\n2. Logic: SC judges ke liye 4 senior-most chahiye, par HC judges ke liye CJI + 2 senior-most judges of SC kafi hain. \\n3. Extra Fact: Isme us state ke HC ke Chief Justice ki rai bhi li jati hai.

qe: The High Court of 'Patna' celebrated its Centenary (100 years) in?
qh: पटना उच्च न्यायालय ने अपना शताब्दी वर्ष (100 वर्ष) कब मनाया?
e: 1. Core Concept: Bihar Pride History. \\n2. Logic: 1916 mein bana tha, isliye 2016 mein 100 saal pure hue. \\n3. Extra Fact: Iska udghatan Lord Hardinge ne kiya tha.

qe: What is 'Court-on-trial'?
qh: 'कोर्ट-ऑन-ट्रायल' क्या है?
o: High Court when hearing evidence (हाई कोर्ट जब सबूत सुन रहा हो)
e: 1. Core Concept: Original side of HC. \\n2. Logic: High Court sirf appeal hi nahi sunta, kuch cases (Election disputes) mein wo pehli baar gawahi bhi sunta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Article 225 purane HCs ki powers ko protect karta hai.

qe: Which Article provides for the 'Recruitment of persons other than district judges' to judicial service?
qh: न्यायिक सेवा में 'जिला न्यायाधीशों के अलावा अन्य व्यक्तियों' की भर्ती का प्रावधान कौन सा अनुच्छेद करता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: BPSC/PCS-J recruitment. \\n2. Logic: Bihar Civil Judge (Junior Division) ki bharti Governor, BPSC aur High Court milkar karte hain. \\n3. Extra Fact: District judge (Direct) ke liye Art 233 hai, baaki ke liye 234.

qe: What is 'Bench' in Judiciary?
qh: न्यायपालिका में 'बेंच' (Bench) क्या है?
o: Group of judges hearing a case (मामले की सुनवाई करने वाले न्यायाधीशों का समूह)
e: 1. Core Concept: Collective Wisdom. \\n2. Logic: Division bench mein 2, aur Full bench mein 3 ya usse zyada judges hote hain. \\n3. Extra Fact: Constitutional cases (Art 145) mein kam se kam 5 judges ki bench hona zaroori hai.

qe: Who is the 'Highest Judicial Officer' in a District?
qh: जिले में 'उच्चतम न्यायिक अधिकारी' कौन होता है?
o: District and Sessions Judge (जिला एवं सत्र न्यायाधीश)
e: 1. Core Concept: Local Judiciary head. \\n2. Logic: District level par ye officer civil aur criminal dono matters ka boss hota hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Iski appointment Governor karta hai Patna HC ki rai se.

qe: What is 'Judicial Review' of 'Administrative Action'?
qh: 'प्रशासनिक कार्रवाई' की 'न्यायिक समीक्षा' क्या है?
o: Reviewing decisions of police/officers (पुलिस/अधिकारियों के निर्णयों की समीक्षा)
e: 1. Core Concept: Checking Red-tapism. \\n2. Logic: Agar koi officer bina logic ke aapka license radd karde ya naukri se nikal de, toh HC use Article 226 mein check karta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Isme 'Certiorari' writ sabse zyada use hoti hai.

qe: Can the 'High Court' punish for the contempt of 'Tribunals' like CAT?
qh: क्या हाई कोर्ट CAT जैसे 'ट्रिब्यूनल' की अवमानna के लिए दंड दे सकता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Superintending Power. \\n2. Logic: L. Chandra Kumar case mein SC ne kaha ki Tribunals HC ke under aate hain. \\n3. Extra Fact: Article 227 ke tehat HC in par nazar rakhta hai.

qe: Which case ruled that 'Preamble is an integral part of the Constitution'?
qh: किस मामले ने फैसला सुनाया कि 'प्रस्तावना संविधान का अभिन्न अंग है'?
e: 1. Core Concept: Reversing Berubari. \\n2. Logic: 1973 mein Kesavananda ne ise 'Part' mana aur 1994 mein Bommai case ne ise 'Integral Part' (mazboot ang) mana. \\n3. Extra Fact: Isse pehle 1960 mein SC ise part nahi maanta tha.

qe: What is 'Social Justice' according to the Supreme Court?
qh: सुप्रीम कोर्ट के अनुसार 'सामाजिक न्याय' क्या है?
o: Removal of all inequalities in life (जीवन में सभी असमानताओं को दूर करना)
e: 1. Core Concept: Holistic Equality. \\n2. Logic: SC ne kayi baar kaha hai ki Social Justice ka matlab hai ki har insaan ko dignity aur development ka mauka mile. \\n3. Extra Fact: Iska base Article 38 (DPSP) mein hai.

qe: Article 143 says the President may 'Consult' SC. Does it apply to 'Pre-constitutional' treaties?
qh: अनुच्छेद 143 कहता है राष्ट्रपति SC से सलाह ले सकते हैं। क्या यह 'पूर्व-संवैधानिक' संधियों पर लागू होता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Advisory scope. \\n2. Logic: 1950 se pehle ki kisi sandhi (treaty) par agar koi jhagda ho, toh President SC se mandatory rai maang sakte hain. \\n3. Extra Fact: Aise maamlo mein SC ko rai dena hi padta hai (obligatory).

qe: What is 'Judicial Activism' vs 'Judicial Overreach'?
qh: 'न्यायिक सक्रियता' बनाम 'न्यायिक अतिरेक' क्या है?
o: Overreach is when judiciary crosses its limit (अतिरेक तब है जब न्यायपालिका अपनी सीमा लांघती है)
e: 1. Core Concept: Balance of Power. \\n2. Logic: Rights bachana 'Activism' hai, par sarkar ka kaam khud karne lagna (jaise budget banana) 'Overreach' (galat) hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye behes India mein hamesha chalti rehti hai.

qe: Can a person with 'Criminal Record' become a judge?
qh: क्या 'आपराधिक रिकॉर्ड' वाला व्यक्ति न्यायाधीश बन सकता है?
o: Only if he is a lawyer
e: 1. Core Concept: Integrity of Judiciary. \\n2. Logic: Character verification bahut strict hota hai. Moral turpitude ka koi bhi case disqualification ka karan banta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Judges ke liye 'Conduct Rules' bahut kathor hote hain.

qe: Who was the first Indian Chief Justice of Patna High Court?
qh: पटना उच्च न्यायालय के पहले भारतीय मुख्य न्यायाधीश कौन थे?
o: Justice Lakshmi Kant Jha (जस्टिस लक्ष्मी कांत झा)
e: 1. Core Concept: Bihar Judicial History. \\n2. Logic: 1950 mein wo pehle Indian CJ bane the Patna HC ke. \\n3. Extra Fact: Unka tenure bahut hi prabhavshali raha tha.

qe: What is 'Munsif' court?
qh: 'मुंसिफ' न्यायालय क्या है?
o: Lowest civil court in a district (जिले में सबसे निचला दीवानी न्यायालय)
e: 1. Core Concept: Subordinate structure. \\n2. Logic: Zameen ya paiso ke chote cases sabse pehle Munsif ke paas jate hain. \\n3. Extra Fact: Iske upar Sub-judge aur phir District judge hote hain.

qe: Which Article allows SC to 'Review' any of its judgments?
qh: कौन सा अनुच्छेद SC को अपने किसी भी फैसले की 'समीक्षा' करने की अनुमति देता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Inherent Power. \\n2. Logic: Agar koi badi galti (error apparent on face) ho jaye, toh SC ise badalta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Review petition 30 din ke andar file karni hoti hai.

qe: What is 'Ad-hoc Judge' in Supreme Court?
qh: सुप्रीम कोर्ट में 'तदर्थ न्यायाधीश' (Ad-hoc Judge) क्या है?
o: Temporary judge for lack of quorum (कोरम की कमी के लिए अस्थायी न्यायाधीश)
e: 1. Core Concept: Quorum fulfillment. \\n2. Logic: Agar SC ki baithak ke liye minimum judges (quorum) na hon, toh CJI President ki ijazat se HC judge ko bulata hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye sirf Supreme Court mein hota hai, HC mein nahi.

qe: What is 'Justice-on-Wheels'?
qh: 'जस्टिस-ऑन-व्हील्स' क्या है?
o: Mobile courts going to remote areas (दूर-दराज के इलाकों में जाने वाले मोबाइल कोर्ट)
e: 1. Core Concept: Reach of Justice. \\n2. Logic: Gaon ke log jo court nahi aa sakte, unke liye mobile courts wahan ja kar sunvai karte hain. \\n3. Extra Fact: Haryana aur Punjab mein ye kafi popular hua tha.

qe: Article 142 is sometimes called 'Judicial Dictatorship'. Why?
qh: अनुच्छेद 142 को कभी-कभी 'न्यायिक तानाशाही' क्यों कहा जाता है?
o: It gives SC unlimited power to pass any order for justice (न्याय के लिए किसी भी आदेश को पारित करने की असीमित शक्ति)
e: 1. Core Concept: Supreme power for equity. \\n2. Logic: Iska misuse na ho isliye SC ise 'Extraordinary' halat mein hi use karta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Liquor ban on highways isi Article ke tehat laya gaya tha.

qe: Which Article provides for the 'Salary of Judges' being charged on the Consolidated Fund?
qh: कौन सा अनुच्छेद न्यायाधीशों के 'वेतन' को संचित निधि पर भारित होने का प्रावधान करता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Financial Independence. \\n2. Logic: Inki salary par Parliament mein vote nahi hota taaki koi pressure na bana sake. \\n3. Extra Fact: Salary sirf 'Financial Emergency' mein hi kam ki ja sakti hai.

qe: Who is the 'Highest Law Officer' in a State?
qh: राज्य में 'उच्चतम कानून अधिकारी' कौन होता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Legal Advisor to State. \\n2. Logic: Article 165 ke tehat Advocate General sarkar ka vakeel hota hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Iski qualification ek HC judge ke barabar honi chahiye.

qe: What is 'Judicial Activism' vs 'Judicial Restraint'?
qh: 'न्यायिक सक्रियता' बनाम 'न्यायिक संयम' क्या है?
o: Restraint means judges follow existing laws strictly (संयम का अर्थ है न्यायाधीश कानूनों का सख्ती से पालन करते हैं)
e: 1. Core Concept: Interpretation style. \\n2. Logic: Restraint wale judges kehte hain ki naya kanoon banana sirf Sansad ka kaam hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: India mein dono ka mishran chalta hai.

qe: Can the 'High Court' hear a case related to 'Inter-state Water Disputes'?
qh: क्या हाई कोर्ट 'अंतर-राज्यीय जल विवादों' से संबंधित मामला सुन सकता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Constitutional Exclusion. \\n2. Logic: Article 262 ke tehat inka faisla Tribunals karte hain, Courts ka jurisdiction isme nahi hota. \\n3. Extra Fact: Cauvery ya Krishna water dispute iska example hai.

qe: What is the 'Seal of Supreme Court' called?
qh: सुप्रीम कोर्ट की 'मोहर' को क्या कहा जाता है?
o: Ashoka Capital with Slogan (अशोक स्तंभ स्लोगन के साथ)
e: 1. Core Concept: Judicial Identity. \\n2. Logic: Is par likha hota hai- 'Yato Dharmastato Jayah'. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye mahabharata ke Bhishma Parva se liya gaya hai.

qe: What is the 'Doctrine of Colorable Legislation'?
qh: 'छद्म विधान का सिद्धांत' (Doctrine of Colorable Legislation) क्या है?
o: Doing indirectly what cannot be done directly (जो प्रत्यक्ष रूप से नहीं किया जा सकता, उसे अप्रत्यक्ष रूप से करना)
e: 1. Core Concept: Fraud on Constitution. \\n2. Logic: Agar Sansad ke paas koi power nahi hai, toh wo 'Dressing' (ghumakar) karke use nahi bana sakti. \\n3. Extra Fact: Judiciary ise Article 13 ke andar check karti hai.

qe: Who decides the 'Rules of the High Court'?
qh: हाई कोर्ट के 'नियम' कौन तय करता है?
o: The High Court with approval of Governor (राज्यपाल के अनुमोदन से हाई कोर्ट स्वयं)
e: 1. Core Concept: Administrative Independence. \\n2. Logic: Article 225 aur 227 ke tehat HC apne rules khud banata hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Patna High Court ke apne 'Patna High Court Rules' hain.

qe: What is 'Judicial Review' of 'Expulsion of MPs'?
qh: 'सांसदों के निष्कासन' की 'न्यायिक समीक्षा' क्या है?
o: Court can check if procedure was followed (कोर्ट जाँच सकता है कि क्या प्रक्रिया का पालन किया गया)
e: 1. Core Concept: Limit on Privileges. \\n2. Logic: Raja Ram Pal case mein SC ne kaha ki Sansad manmani nahi kar sakti, procedure check kiya jayega. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye Parliamentary Privileges (Art 105) par ek bada control hai.

qe: Which Article provides for 'National Judicial Academy'?
qh: 'राष्ट्रीय न्यायिक अकादमी' का प्रावधान किस संदर्भ में है?
o: Administrative decision for training (प्रशिक्षण के लिए प्रशासनिक निर्णय)
e: 1. Core Concept: Training of Judges. \\n2. Logic: Bhopal mein ye academy judges ko naye kanoono ki training deti hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ise 1993 mein banaya gaya tha.

qe: What is 'Public Interest Litigation' (PIL) also called in legal terms?
qh: कानूनी शब्दावली में PIL को और क्या कहा जाता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Collective Rights. \\n2. Logic: Chunki ye pure samaj ke liye hota hai, isliye ise Social Action Litigation bhi kehte hain. \\n3. Extra Fact: Justice Krishna Iyer ne ye term diya tha.

qe: Who can remove 'Advocate General' of Bihar?
qh: बिहार के 'महाधिवक्ता' को कौन हटा सकता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Pleasure of Governor. \\n2. Logic: Article 165 ke tehat ye Governor ki marzi tak hi pad par rehte hain. \\n3. Extra Fact: Attorney General ko President hatata hai.

qe: What is the 'Subordinate Judiciary' composed of?
qh: 'अधीनस्थ न्यायपालिका' किससे बनी है?
o: District Courts and below (जिला न्यायालय और उससे नीचे)
e: 1. Core Concept: Local Hierarchy. \\n2. Logic: HC ke niche aane wale District, Sub-division aur Munsif courts subordinate hain. \\n3. Extra Fact: Inka control Article 235 mein HC ke paas hai.

qe: Which case is related to 'Separation of Powers'?
qh: 'शक्तियों के पृथक्करण' से संबंधित कौन सा मामला है?
o: Indira Gandhi vs Raj Narain (इंदिरा गांधी बनाम राज नारायण)
e: 1. Core Concept: Checks and Balances. \\n2. Logic: SC ne kaha ki Judiciary, Executive aur Legislature ke beech deewar honi chahiye. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye Samvidhan ka 'Basic Structure' hai.

qe: What is 'Fast Track' justice for Women?
qh: महिलाओं के लिए 'फास्ट ट्रैक' न्याय क्या है?
o: FTCs for rape and POCSO cases (रेप और पोक्सो मामलों के लिए FTC)
e: 1. Core Concept: Sensitive Justice. \\n2. Logic: In cases ko jaldi khatam karne ke liye special FTCs banaye gaye hain. \\n3. Extra Fact: Nirbhaya fund se inka kharch chalta hai.

qe: Article 137 allows Review. Does it apply to 'Interlocutory Orders'?
qh: अनुच्छेद 137 समीक्षा की अनुमति देता है। क्या यह 'अंतरिम आदेशों' पर लागू होता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Finality of Law. \\n2. Logic: Review sirf 'Final Judgment' par hota hai, bich-bich mein diye gaye temporary orders par nahi. \\n3. Extra Fact: Interlocutory orders ko normal appeal mein challenge kiya jata hai.

qe: Who is the 'Father of Legal Aid' in India?
qh: भारत में 'कानूनी सहायता' का जनक किसे कहा जाता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Access to poor. \\n2. Logic: Unhone Article 39A ko real banaya aur NALSA ka concept laya. \\n3. Extra Fact: Unhone hi PIL ko ghar-ghar pahunchaya.

qe: What is 'Judicial Indiscipline' by HC?
qh: HC द्वारा 'न्यायिक अनुशासनहीनता' क्या है?
o: Not following Supreme Court rulings (सुप्रीम कोर्ट के फैसलों का पालन न करना)
e: 1. Core Concept: Article 141. \\n2. Logic: Agar HC ka judge jaan-boojh kar SC ke faisle ko ignore kare, toh ise indiscipline mana jata hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Iske liye Contempt process ho sakta hai.

qe: Who was the 'Longest Serving' CJI?
qh: सबसे लंबे समय तक सेवा करने वाले CJI कौन थे?
e: 1. Core Concept: Judicial Records. \\n2. Logic: Unhone lagbhag 7 saal (1978-85) tak CJI ke roop mein kaam kiya. \\n3. Extra Fact: Unke bete D.Y. Chandrachud bhi CJI bane.

qe: Can the 'High Court' be called the 'Guardian of the Constitution'?
qh: क्या हाई कोर्ट को 'संविधान का संरक्षक' कहा जा सकता है?
o: Yes, in its jurisdiction (हाँ, अपने क्षेत्राधिकार में)
e: 1. Core Concept: Dual Protection. \\n2. Logic: SC poore desh ke liye hai, par HC apne state ke andar Samvidhan ki raksha karta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: HC ke paas bhi Judicial Review ki power hai.

qe: Under Article 145, what is the minimum number of judges required to hear a 'Substantial Question of Law' or Constitutional case?
qh: अनुच्छेद 145 के तहत, संवैधानिक मामले की सुनवाई के लिए कम से कम कितने न्यायाधीशों की आवश्यकता होती है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Constitutional Bench. \\n2. Logic: Samvidhan ki vyakhya itni badi cheez hai ki kam se kam 5 judges (Odd number mein) milkar faisla lete hain. \\n3. Extra Fact: Aaj tak ki sabse badi bench Kesavananda case mein 13 judges ki thi.

qe: Who decides the 'Officers and Servants' of the Supreme Court and their conditions of service?
qh: सुप्रीम कोर्ट के अधिकारियों और सेवकों की सेवा शर्तों का निर्णय कौन करता है?
o: Chief Justice of India (भारत के मुख्य न्यायाधीश)
e: 1. Core Concept: Administrative Autonomy. \\n2. Logic: Article 146 ke tehat CJI ko ye power di gayi hai taaki Judiciary par Executive ka control na rahe. \\n3. Extra Fact: Iska sara administrative kharcha 'Consolidated Fund of India' par charged hota hai.

qe: What is the 'In-house Procedure' of the Judiciary?
qh: न्यायपालिका की 'इन-हाउस प्रक्रिया' क्या है?
o: A system to investigate complaints against judges (न्यायाधीशों के खिलाफ शिकायतों की जांच की व्यवस्था)
e: 1. Core Concept: Judicial Accountability. \\n2. Logic: Agar kisi judge par bhrashtachar ka aarop lage, toh CJI internal committee banakar jaanch karwate hain. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye procedure 1997 mein SC ne khud banaya tha taaki system saaf rahe.

qe: The concept of 'Basic Structure' was first inspired by which German jurist?
qh: 'मूल संरचना' की अवधारणा सबसे पहले किस जर्मन विधिवेत्ता से प्रेरित थी?
e: 1. Core Concept: Intellectual Origin. \\n2. Logic: Dietrich Conrad ne BHU (Varanasi) mein ek lecture diya tha jisse inspired hokar Justice Khanna ne ise Indian context mein laya. \\n3. Extra Fact: Unka logic tha ki 'Aisa koi power nahi jo khud ko hi khatam karde'.

qe: What is 'Judicial Comity'?
qh: 'न्यायिक सौजन्य' (Judicial Comity) क्या है?
o: Courts showing respect to each other's decisions (अदालतों का एक-दूसरे के निर्णयों के प्रति सम्मान दिखाना)
e: 1. Core Concept: Harmony. \\n2. Logic: Ek court dusre court ke jurisdiction mein tab tak dakhal nahi deta jab tak bahut zaroori na ho. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye 'Integrated Judiciary' ki garima banaye rakhta hai.

qe: Which Article allows the President to appoint 'Acting Chief Justice' of SC?
qh: कौन सा अनुच्छेद राष्ट्रपति को SC के 'कार्यकारी मुख्य न्यायाधीश' नियुक्त करने की अनुमति देता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Continuity of Office. \\n2. Logic: Agar CJI bimar hon ya pad khali ho, toh President kisi bhi SC judge ko temporary CJI bana deta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Article 127 'Ad-hoc judges' ke liye hai, dono mein confuse mat hona.

qe: What is the 'Special Leave Petition' (SLP) duration limit?
qh: 'विशेष अनुमति याचिका' (SLP) दायर करने की समय सीमा क्या है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Article 136 Procedure. \\n2. Logic: High Court ke faisle ke 90 din ke andar aapko SC mein SLP lagani hoti hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye ek 'Residual Power' hai, matlab ye kisi ka adhikar nahi balki SC ki marzi hai.

qe: Who was the Chief Justice of India during the 'Golaknath Case'?
qh: 'गोलकनाथ मामले' के दौरान भारत के मुख्य न्यायाधीश कौन थे?
o: Justice K. Subba Rao (जस्टिस के. सुब्बा राव)
e: 1. Core Concept: Landmark Headship. \\n2. Logic: Unki leadership mein 11 judges ki bench ne kaha tha ki Parliament Rights ko badal nahi sakti. \\n3. Extra Fact: Is faisle ne Indira Gandhi sarkar ko '24th Amendment' lane par majboor kiya tha.

qe: What is 'Court of Equity'?
qh: 'न्याय का न्यायालय' (Court of Equity) क्या है?
o: A court that provides justice beyond strict technicalities of law (एक न्यायालय जो कानून की सख्त तकनीकी से परे न्याय देता है)
e: 1. Core Concept: Fairness. \\n2. Logic: Kabhi-kabhi kanoon bahut 'Strict' hota hai, tab SC Article 142 ka use karke 'Equity' (Barabari) ke adhar par faisla deta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: English Law mein iska alag system tha, par India mein SC hi Court of Equity hai.

qe: The High Court of 'Manipur' was established in which year?
qh: मणिपुर उच्च न्यायालय की स्थापना किस वर्ष हुई थी?
e: 1. Core Concept: North-East Judicial Reforms. \\n2. Logic: 2013 mein teen naye HC bane- Manipur, Meghalaya aur Tripura. \\n3. Extra Fact: Isse pehle ye sab Guwahati High Court ke under aate the.

qe: What is 'Judicial Vandalism'?
qh: 'न्यायिक बर्बरता' (Judicial Vandalism) क्या है?
o: Disturbing established legal principles unnecessarily (स्थापित कानूनी सिद्धांतों को अनावश्यक रूप से बिगाड़ना)
e: 1. Core Concept: Legal Ethics. \\n2. Logic: Jab ek judge bina kisi bade logic ke purane aur set kanoono ko ulat-pulat kar deta hai, toh use kanooni bhasha mein Vandalism kehte hain. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye term aksar criticism mein use hota hai.

qe: Under Article 134A, when is a 'Certificate for Appeal' to SC granted by HC?
qh: अनुच्छेद 134A के तहत, HC द्वारा SC में अपील के लिए प्रमाण पत्र कब दिया जाता है?
o: Immediately after judgment (निर्णय के तुरंत बाद)
e: 1. Core Concept: Speeding Up Appeal. \\n2. Logic: HC faisla sunate waqt hi khud keh sakta hai ki 'Ye maamla SC jane layak hai'. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ise 44th Amendment se joda gaya tha.

qe: What is the 'Rule of Precedent' or 'Stare Decisis'?
qh: 'मिसाल का नियम' (Stare Decisis) क्या है?
o: To stand by things decided (तय की गई बातों पर टिके रहना)
Giving new names to old laws
e: 1. Core Concept: Consistency. \\n2. Logic: Iska matlab hai ki jo faisla ek baar ho gaya, use future mein waisa hi mana jayega taaki kanoon mein stability rahe. \\n3. Extra Fact: Article 141 isi principle par chalta hai.

qe: Which Article gives 'Civil Courts' power over civil matters?
qh: 'दीवानी न्यायालयों' को दीवानी मामलों पर शक्ति कौन सा अनुच्छेद देता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: CPC (Code of Civil Procedure). \\n2. Logic: Samvidhan High Court/SC ke liye hai, par normal civil courts (Munsif, Sub-judge) CPC se chalti hain. \\n3. Extra Fact: Section 9 kehta hai ki Civil Courts har wo case sun sakti hain jo kanoon ne mana nahi kiya.

qe: Who is the 'Guardian of Public Purse' and works with Judiciary?
qh: 'सार्वजनिक धन का संरक्षक' कौन है जो न्यायपालिका के साथ काम करता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Accountability. \\n2. Logic: CAG audit karta hai aur agar koi paisa galat kharch hua, toh Judiciary uspar action leti hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: CAG ki report Public Accounts Committee check karti hai.

qe: What is 'Judicial Review' of 'Expulsion of MPs'?
qh: 'सांसदों के निष्कासन' की 'न्यायिक समीक्षा' किस केस में तय हुई?
o: Raja Ram Pal Case (राजा राम पाल मामला)
e: 1. Core Concept: Parliament vs Court. \\n2. Logic: SC ne kaha ki agar Sansad kisi MP ko galat tarike se nikalti hai, toh Court use check kar sakta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye 2007 ka famous case tha.

qe: Does a 'Retired' High Court judge get pension from?
qh: हाई कोर्ट के 'सेवानिवृत्त' न्यायाधीश को पेंशन कहाँ से मिलती है?
o: Consolidated Fund of India (भारत की संचित निधि)
e: 1. Core Concept: Financial Anomaly. \\n2. Logic: Salary State fund se milti hai, par pension Centre (India) fund se milti hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye isliye taaki judge ko kisi ek state ke pressure mein na rehna pade.

qe: What is 'Judicial Review' of 'Tenth Schedule' (Anti-defection)?
qh: 'दसवीं अनुसूची' (दलबदल) की 'न्यायिक समीक्षा' किस केस में हुई?
e: 1. Core Concept: Speaker's Power Limit. \\n2. Logic: Speaker ka faisla aakhri nahi hai, SC use check kar sakta hai agar wo bhedbhav kare. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye 1992 ka historical faisla tha.

qe: Which Article provides for 'National Judicial Appointments Commission' (abolished later)?
qh: 'राष्ट्रीय न्यायिक नियुक्ति आयोग' (NJAC) का अनुच्छेद क्या था?
e: 1. Core Concept: 99th Amendment. \\n2. Logic: Sarkar ne teeno Articles add kiye the Collegium hatane ke liye, par SC ne teeno ko 'Zero' kar diya. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ise 'Judicial Independence' ka violation mana gaya.

qe: What is 'Tele-Law' service?
qh: 'टेली-लॉ' सेवा क्या है?
o: Legal advice through video conferencing for poor (गरीबों के लिए वीडियो कॉन्फ्रेंसिंग के माध्यम से कानूनी सलाह)
e: 1. Core Concept: E-Justice. \\n2. Logic: Common Service Centres (CSC) ke zariye gaon ke log bade vakeelo se free salah le sakte hain. \\n3. Extra Fact: Isne Article 39A (Free legal aid) ko digital bana diya.

qe: Can the Supreme Court hear 'International' cases?
qh: क्या सुप्रीम कोर्ट 'अंतर्राष्ट्रीय' मामले सुन सकता है?
o: Only if India is a party (केवल तभी जब भारत एक पक्ष हो)
e: 1. Core Concept: Territorial Limit. \\n2. Logic: SC ka jurisdiction sirf India tak hai. International maamlo ke liye ICJ (Hague) jana padta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Halanki SC videshi treaties ko interpret kar sakta hai.

qe: What is 'Judicial Activism' also called?
qh: 'न्यायिक सक्रियता' को और क्या कहा जाता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Positive term. \\n2. Logic: Jab kanoon waqt ke sath badalta aur active hota hai, toh use Dynamism kehte hain. \\n3. Extra Fact: Iska ulta 'Judicial Overreach' hai (Negative term).

qe: Who was the first woman judge of Patna High Court?
qh: पटना उच्च न्यायालय की पहली महिला न्यायाधीश कौन थीं?
o: Justice Indu Prabha Singh (जस्टिस इंदु प्रभा सिंह)
e: 1. Core Concept: Bihar Judicial History. \\n2. Logic: 1990 mein wo Patna HC ki pehli mahila judge bani thin. \\n3. Extra Fact: Mahilaon ka pratinidhitva Judiciary mein badh raha hai.

qe: What is 'Court-fee' used for?
qh: 'कोर्ट-शुल्क' का उपयोग किस लिए किया जाता है?
o: To prevent frivolous litigation (अनावश्यक मुकदमों को रोकने के लिए)
e: 1. Core Concept: Filtering Cases. \\n2. Logic: Thodi fees hone se log bina wajah ke cases kam karte hain. \\n3. Extra Fact: Garibo ke liye ye fees Article 39A mein maaf kar di jati hai.

qe: Which Article allows SC to transfer a case to 'Itself' from HC?
qh: कौन सा अनुच्छेद SC को HC से मामला 'अपने पास' स्थानांतरित करने की अनुमति देता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Withdrawal of Cases. \\n2. Logic: Agar koi bahut bada maamla hai jo poore desh ko affect karta hai, toh SC use HC se chin kar khud sunta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ise 42nd Amendment se joda gaya tha.

qe: What is 'Amicus Brief'?
qh: 'एमिकस ब्रीफ' क्या है?
o: Legal document filed by a friend of court (अदालत के मित्र द्वारा दायर कानूनी दस्तावेज)
e: 1. Core Concept: Expertise in writing. \\n2. Logic: Jab koi expert court ko written mein koi naya point samjhata hai, toh use Amicus Brief kehte hain. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye complex tech ya science cases mein bahut kaam aata hai.

qe: Who decides the 'Language' of Subordinate Courts in Bihar?
qh: बिहार में अधीनस्थ न्यायालयों की 'भाषा' कौन तय करता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Local Connectivity. \\n2. Logic: CrPC (BNSS) ke tehat State Govt decide karti hai ki unke district courts mein Hindi, English ya regional bhasha chalegi. \\n3. Extra Fact: Bihar mein Hindi mukhya bhasha hai.

qe: What is 'Recusal' of a judge?
qh: न्यायाधीश का 'हटना' (Recusal) क्या है?
o: Judge withdrawing from a case due to conflict of interest (हितों के टकराव के कारण न्यायाधीश का मामले से हटना)
e: 1. Core Concept: Impartiality. \\n2. Logic: Agar kisi case mein judge ka rishtedar ya purana dost shamil ho, toh judge khud hi case chhod deta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye 'Natural Justice' ka bada hissa hai.

qe: Article 135 gives SC power over which old court?
qh: अनुच्छेद 135 SC को किस पुराने न्यायालय की शक्तियों पर अधिकार देता है?
o: Federal Court of India (भारत का संघीय न्यायालय)
e: 1. Core Concept: Succession of Power. \\n2. Logic: 1950 se pehle jo shaktiyan Federal Court ke paas thi, wo sab SC ko mil gayi. \\n3. Extra Fact: Federal Court 1935 Act se bana tha.

qe: What is 'Judicial Indiscipline' (Vertical)?
qh: 'न्यायिक अनुशासनहीनता' (ऊर्ध्वाधर) क्या है?
o: High Court not following Supreme Court (हाई कोर्ट द्वारा सुप्रीम कोर्ट का पालन न करना)
e: 1. Core Concept: Hierarchy. \\n2. Logic: Article 141 ke tehat SC boss hai. Agar HC uski baat na mane, toh ise vertical indiscipline kehte hain. \\n3. Extra Fact: Iske liye Contempt of Court action liya ja sakta hai.

qe: What is 'Review Petition' time limit?
qh: 'पुनर्विचार याचिका' की समय सीमा क्या है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Correcting errors. \\n2. Logic: Faisla aane ke 30 din ke andar hi review file karna hota hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Isme koi nayi behes nahi hoti, sirf purane records check hote hain.

qe: Which Article deals with 'Special Jurisdiction' of SC for Bihar Governor?
qh: बिहार के राज्यपाल के लिए SC के 'विशेष क्षेत्राधिकार' से कौन सा अनुच्छेद संबंधित है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Immunity. \\n2. Logic: Governor ko unke kamo ke liye kisi court mein jawabdeh nahi banaya ja sakta jab tak wo pad par hain. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye protection President ko bhi milti hai.
